datasheet.title: BSS138L, BVSS138L – MOSFET – Power, N-Channel, SOT-23, 200 mA, 50 V

sources: onsemi BSS138L, BVSS138L datasheet, BSS138LT1/D Rev. 15, September 2026 (www.onsemi.com/download/data-sheet/pdf/bss138lt1-d.pdf, read 2026-10-31; LCSC's copy is an older 5-page edition, sha256 9299f11ba9d3…, not used)
p. 1 maximum ratings (TA = 25 °C): VDSS 50 V, VGS ±20 V, ID 200 mA continuous, IDM 800 mA (tp ≤ 10 ms), PD 225 mW, TJ/Tstg –55 … 150 °C, RθJA 556 °C/W

p. 2 electrical characteristics: V(BR)DSS ≥ 50 V; IDSS ≤ 0.1 µA (25 V) / 0.5 µA (50 V); IGSS ±0.1 µA; VGS(th) 0.85 … 1.5 V at ID 1 mA (no typical value); rDS(on) 5.6 Ω typ / 10 Ω max at VGS 2.75 V, ID < 200 mA, TA –40 … +85 °C, 3.5 Ω max at VGS 5.0 V, 200 mA; Ciss 40/50 pF, Coss 12/25 pF, Crss 3.5/5 pF typ/max; td(on), td(off) ≤ 20 ns
p. 3–4 typical curves: figure 1 output characteristics, figure 8 RDS(on) about 3.3 Ω at VGS 2.75 V and 25 °C, figure 11 body diode about 0.63 V at 10 mA (25 °C)
package p. 6: SOT-23 style 21 – pin 1 gate, 2 source, 3 drain; = EasyEDA symbol of C82045 (1 G, 2 S, 3 D), edakit part import 2026-10-31

spice: assumption – level 1 fitted by Claude, no manufacturer model read: VTO = VGS(th) max 1.5 V and KP 0.082 A/V² so that RDS(on) stays within the maxima (9.8 Ω at 2.75 V, 3.5 Ω at 5 V) – a worst-case switch, its saturation current far below the typical curves; IS 2.6e-13 A from the body diode, 10 mA at 0.63 V (figure 11)
JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31: Extended Part, 570 816 pcs; LCSC product data 2026-10-31: 570 810 pcs, RoHS

compliance.source: onsemi BSS138LT1/D Rev. 15, p. 1 features ('Pb-Free, Halogen Free/BFR Free and are RoHS Compliant'), read 2026-10-31

notes: Small-signal N-MOSFET with its on-resistance specified from VGS 2.75 V – the pass transistor of the bidirectional I2C level shifter (block i2c-level-shift).

checked: SOT-23 style 21: 1 gate, 2 source, 3 drain = EasyEDA symbol
maximum ratings: VDSS 50 V, VGS ±20 V, ID 200 mA, PD 225 mW, RθJA 556 °C/W, TJ –55 … 150 °C
capacitances Ciss ≤ 50 pF, Coss ≤ 25 pF, Crss ≤ 5 pF
open: SPICE model is a worst-case level-1 fit by Claude, not a manufacturer model
no body-diode rating (IS, VSD at 1 A) in this datasheet: is_body_max_a and vsd_v_at_1a not entered
pin numbers are not printed on the drawing beyond style 21 – the footprint's pad 3 alone is the drain
